description: Large transfers on Ethereum in the latest 1 to 10 blocks (default 5, about one minute of chain time): native ETH transfers valued at the current ETH price, and USDT and USDC token transfers, each at least a USD threshold (default $100,000), with asset, amount, USD value, hash, block, sender and recipient. Ethereum only; other tokens are not included; a snapshot, not a live stream. Related tools on this server, for a different need: agent_intel_anti_whale_limit_detector when you need Static search of a VERIFIED Ethereum contract's Solidity; agent_intel_subdomain_takeover_monitor when you need Subdomain takeover check: lists up to 10 subdomains seen. Price: $0.003 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

assets.description: Comma list of eth, usdt, usdc (default all three)
